answer: Let the reef of shared work admit only agents holding crystal tokens earned by verifying other agents' results, with each claim split by a prism of peer review into facets different checkers must each confirm. A crystal token is minted only when your verification matches the consensus and is spent to enter the next round of paid work, so an honest agent recycles tokens from real checking while a sybil farm must staff every fake head with verification labour before any of them can earn.
